500950.name: Zbehy

501590.name: Horná Potôň

501662.name: Janíky

502715.name: Santovka

The page is gone from the live site (404), the three files answer 404 live, and the Internet Archive has none of them, so their text is unavailable.

503321.name: Lipová
503321.note: The current website keeps election documents only for the October 2026 elections (and results of the 2026 referendum); no resolution on the 2018 obvody of this vote and no older election pages. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

503363.name: Maňa
503363.note: The archived 2018 notice-board page (2018-08-22) links 'Oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov a o utvorení volebných obvodov', but that page was never archived and the old site is gone (404); the current site keeps only 2022+ documents.

503584.name: Štúrovo

503592.name: Šurany
503592.note: No council resolution on the 2018 obvody found on the elections pages (they start in 2019/2022). The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

504025.name: Šaľa

504203.name: Senica
504203.note: The city's election articles are reused for each new vote (the municipal and regional pages now show 2026 only), so this vote's documents are no longer linked; older files survive only under unknown article/file ids. The Internet Archive's CDX was offline ('Temporarily Offline', HTTP 503) for over 15 minutes, so archived copies could not be searched.

504254.name: Brestovec
504254.note: The 2018 elections page (Komunálne voľby 2018) lists voter information, candidates and results but no resolution or announcement on the 2018 obvody; the resolutions page is empty and site search finds only the 2022 and 2026 obvody. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

504891.name: Šaštín-Stráže
504891.note: The current website keeps only the 2026 elections; the 2018 obvody resolution is not on it, web search found nothing, and the Internet Archive stayed unreachable (504 / connection refused, empty CDX) for more than 15 minutes, so the archived 2018 pages could not be checked.

504998.name: Topoľčany
504998.note: No 2018 council resolution on the obvody found: the council sessions page of 2018 lists the sessions without documents, the EÚT archive (June-November 2018) has no election notices, and topolcany.sk keeps no 2018 elections page. The Internet Archive's CDX timed out or answered 'Temporarily Offline' for most queries (2017, 2019 never answered; 2018, 2020 returned nothing).

505048.name: Ludanice
505048.note: No 2018 council resolution or announcement on the obvody was found: the 2018 elections page holds only the results, and the Internet Archive keeps no 2018 obvody document of obecludanice.sk.

505315.name: Partizánske
505315.note: The archived 2018 elections page links 'Oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov a o utvorení volebných obvodov' (id=1005227) and 'Určenie počtu poslancov a utvorenie volebných obvodov' (id=1045954), but neither PDF was archived and both now return 404; the live elections page starts with 2019.

505897.name: Bzince pod Javorinou

506184.name: Lubina
506184.note: The council resolutions of 31.5.2018 (návrhy, text) and 28.6.2018 (scan; the archived copy is truncated at 1 MB, its readable pages are resolutions 37–43 on minutes, control plan and land sales) contain no resolution on the 2018 obvody; no other 2018 elections document of the municipality is archived and the current site starts with 2022.

506559.name: Trenčianska Teplá
506559.note: The website keeps election pages from 2022 on only; no 2018 resolution on obvody found on the site or by site search. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

508101.name: Modra
508101.note: No document of the 2018 obvody found: the current website starts in 2022, and the Internet Archive's captures of the old site (2017–2021) have no 2018 municipal elections page or council resolution on the obvody.

508217.name: Senec
508217.note: No 2018 announcement of the obvody was found; the only archived obvody announcement (Oznamenie_o_urceni_poctu_poslancov_utvoreni_vo.pdf, captured 2022-12) belongs to the 2022 elections, and the current website has the 2022 and 2026 elections only.

508853.name: Podbrezová
508853.note: The 2018 municipal elections page (archived 2019-07-19) links "Oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov a utvorení volebných obvodov" (download_file_f.php?id=1005992, zverejnené 16.8.2018), but the file is gone live (404) and the Internet Archive never captured it; the page text gives no obvody.

509086.name: Valaská
509086.note: The live 'Komunálne voľby 2018' page has only results, GDPR notices and candidate lists; no resolution on the 2018 obvody. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout, so archived pages could not be checked.

509256.name: Kysucké Nové Mesto
509256.note: The Internet Archive keeps no page or document of the 2018 municipal elections of kysuckenovemesto.sk (its 2018 captures hold no elections page), and the current website keeps only the 2022 and 2026 obvody; web search found nothing.

509345.name: Oščadnica
509345.note: The 2018 announcement (uznesenie č. 17/2018 of 28.06.2018, posted 13.8.2018) defines the 4 obvody (2, 2, 4, 5 seats) only by informal settlement names (Vreščovka, Peňáci, Košariská, Haladeji, Lalíci, Magura, …). Oščadnica has a single part, no streets and one k.ú. in the register, and the document gives no house numbers, so its obvody cannot be written as rules the register can apply.

509451.name: Skalité
509451.note: Skalité has one part and no streets in the address register (all 1,624 addresses by súpisné číslo); the municipality describes its 4 okrsky (and the 2 obvody, each = two okrsky) only by hamlet names and polling stations, never by house numbers, so no rule of the allowed kinds (street, part, k.ú.) can separate them. The website's elections section keeps only the 2023, 2026 pages; no document of this vote with house numbers was found.

509515.name: Vysoká nad Kysucou
509515.note: No 2018 council resolution on the obvody was found: the website's election documents begin with 2022 and the Internet Archive keeps no 2018 obvody document.

509540.name: Dolný Kubín
509540.note: The 2018 elections page (live and archived 2018-07-18) links only voter information, candidate lists and results; no resolution or announcement on the 2018 obvody was found on the website or among the archived download files of June-November 2018 (the archived files of that period are other notices). Web search found nothing on the city website.

509680.name: Hruštín
509680.note: The Internet Archive holds no capture of the municipality's website from 2017 to mid-2019 (its CDX lists two captures in 2017, none in 2018) and the website itself refuses connections from here; no document of this vote found.

509876.name: Nižná
509876.note: The 2018 municipal-elections page and the council's resolution on the 2018 obvody are no longer on the website (the elections page now shows 2026), and the Internet Archive has no capture of them.

510718.name: Liptovské Revúce
510718.note: The website keeps only the 2022 and 2026 obvody announcements; of 2018 the Internet Archive has only the notices on population and on delegating commission members (aktuality 567, 573), no obvody resolution or announcement.

510726.name: Liptovský Hrádok
510726.note: The town's elections page now shows only the elections of October 2026 (older votes' documents are removed) and the notice board has no earlier okrsky or obvody document; the Internet Archive, which keeps earlier pages of this site, was offline (retried). The host also rate-limits requests (HTTP 429), so no further crawling was possible.

510998.name: Ružomberok
510998.note: The new website keeps the 2022 obvody material (re-uploaded 2025/11) and 2026, but nothing on the 2018 obvody; site search finds no 2018 resolution. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

511251.name: Boľkovce
511251.note: No 2018 council resolution on the obvody found: the elections page starts in 2022. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

511391.name: Fiľakovo
511391.note: The 2018 announcement on the obvody (/documents/utabula/2018/volby_2018_oznamenie_o_urceni_poctu_poslancov.pdf) is gone from the live site (404); its archived copy could not be fetched. The Internet Archive stayed unreachable (connection refused / HTTP 429) for well over 15 minutes of retries; the maintainer can retry the archived page.

513326.name: Lednické Rovne
513326.note: The council approved the 2018 obvody on 28 June 2018 (uznesenie, bod 18: 'Volebné obvody, okrsky a počet poslancov pre komunálne voľby v roku 2018 tak, ako boli predložené na rokovanie OZ'), but neither the resolution nor the minutes give the obvody, their okrsky/streets or seats; the proposal itself is not published (zverejnované dokumenty of 28-6-2018 lack it). No 2018 okrsky document or obvody announcement found live or in the Internet Archive (no 2018 elections page captured).

513563.name: Prečín
513563.note: Prečín's website (precin.eu, WordPress media library searched for volby/okrsky/oznámenie) holds okrsky documents only for 2022 (Oznamenie-volby.pdf) and the NR SR election 2023; for this vote only notices of e-mail addresses. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

513601.name: Pružina
513601.note: Found: uznesenie OZ č. 26/2018 (archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20190313114536/http://pruzina.eu/files/po-et-poslancov_volby_komunal_2018.pdf) sets two obvody, "1. Pružina" (7 poslanci) and "2. Priedhorie" (2 poslanci), with no further definition and no date. Priedhorie is neither a part (časť obce) nor a k.ú. in the address register (parts Pružina and Briestenné, k.ú. Pružina and Briestenné), and no document (2018 or later) says which houses form it, so the obvody cannot be written as rules.

513881.name: Prievidza
513881.note: No 2018 document on the obvody was found: the current website keeps the obvody documents of 2022 and 2026, and the archived old notice board (2018–2019 captures) shows only the candidate lists of 2018 by obvod, not the council's decision on the obvody.

515965.name: Dolná Strehová
515965.note: The current website keeps the 2022 and later election documents only; the Internet Archive's 2018 captures of the old site (dolnastrehova.sk) hold only its home page and layout files, no resolution or announcement on the 2018 obvody; web search found nothing.

516295.name: Pôtor
516295.note: The notice board keeps documents mainly from 2026 (some forms from 2019–2025); no 2018 resolution on obvody. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

516546.name: Záhorce
516546.note: No 2018 council resolution or announcement on the obvody was found on the website or in the Internet Archive (the archived notice-board posts on obvody are of 2022).

516589.name: Žiar nad Hronom
516589.note: Resolution 60/2018 of 25.6.2018 names the obvody only by area (Etapa, Stred, Centrum II + stará časť mesta, Pod vršky, IBV + Š. Podhradie) with their seats; the council material with the okrsky and streets of 2018 is not on the website and the Internet Archive did not answer, so the obvody cannot be given streets.

516643.name: Banská Štiavnica
516643.note: Council resolution č. 68/2018 of 27 June 2018 (uzn20180627.pdf) sets 13 seats in 3 obvody (6, 6, 1) but names no streets or okrsky. The 2018 announcements that gave the obvody's okrsky/streets (20180716-pocty-poslancov-a-volebnych-obvodov.pdf, 20180814-pocet-obvodov-poslancov-okrskov.pdf, linked from the archived 2018 elections page) were never captured by the Internet Archive (only 404s from 2025) and are not on the current website, so the 2018 obvody cannot be transcribed.

516830.name: Hronský Beňadik
516830.note: The archived 2018 elections page (24 Sept 2018) links 'Urcenie_poctu_poslancov_obecneho_zastupitelstva_a_urcenie_volebnych_obvodov.pdf' (download id 1006768), but the Internet Archive never captured the file; the 2018 council minutes are not online. No other document of the 2018 obvody was found.

517038.name: Lovčica-Trubín
517038.note: The website's election pages start in 2019 (EP) and have no page for the 2018 municipal elections; no 2018 council resolution on the obvody found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

517097.name: Nová Baňa
517097.note: No 2018 resolution on obvody (the 2018 page has only results) is on the website; Internet Archive offline.

517186.name: Prestavlky
517186.note: The website's notice board keeps only current items (the month archives show the same list) and no election pages for this vote; no okrsky/obvody document found. web.archive.org was unreachable (connection failed) when checked.

517429.name: Belá
517429.note: The council's 2018 resolution or announcement on the obvody is not on the website (the elections page has only results) and the Internet Archive has no capture of it.

517488.name: Divina
517488.note: Divina's okrsky 1 and 2 split the part Divina (whose houses have súpisné čísla only) into 'dolný koniec' and 'horný koniec'; the documents the municipality publishes (2022 resolution 40/2022 and announcement, 2026 Oznámenie, divina.sk) name the okrsky/obvody without listing houses, so no rules can be written; no document of this vote listing houses was found on divina.sk. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

517526.name: Dolný Hričov
517526.note: No document of this vote found: the municipality's notice board keeps its decisions on okrsky (and obvody) only from 2022 on; the Internet Archive has no capture of an okrsky or obvody document of this vote (only 2017 candidate lists and the 2023 referendum article without okrsky). Another vote's decision is not this vote's.

517674.name: Kolárovice
517674.note: The council's resolution no. 188 of 11.6.2018 (Uznesenie OZ 11.6.2018, and the minutes) only sets 2 obvody with 6 and 3 seats, without saying which parts of the municipality form them; the 2018 elections page and okrsky document are no longer on the website (it shows only the 2026 elections). The Internet Archive refused every connection (CDX and snapshots) for over 30 minutes, so no archived pages of earlier votes could be checked.

517755.name: Lietavská Svinná-Babkov
517755.note: The notice board keeps election items from late 2022 on; no 2018 resolution on obvody found. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

518018.name: Štiavnik
518018.note: The current website (since 2022) has no pages for this vote. The old website's notice board (stiavnik.sk/uradna-tabula, ~110 archived list pages of contracts and notices with opaque detail ids) could only partly be fetched: the pages retrieved (2017-11–2018-01, 2019-04–07) list no obvody resolution. The Internet Archive answered mostly HTTP 429 (rate limit) over more than an hour of paced retries; archive.today, Arquivo.pt, Memento TimeTravel and Common Crawl have no copies of the old site's notice board.

518042.name: Terchová
518042.note: The website's 2018 election articles (17.8., 27.8., 26.9.2018) carry voter information, the clerk and candidates but no obvody decision; the only obvody page is of 2014. The Internet Archive refused connections (CDX) during the search.

518158.name: Zvolen
518158.note: The city's archived 2018 elections page (urad.zvolen.sk, captured 2018-10-28) links 'Oznámenie o určení volebných obvodov a počtu poslancov' (id=991461, 11.7.2018), 'OZNÁMENIE o určení počtu poslancov a utvorení volebných obvodov' (id=1024962, 26.9.2018) and 'Volebný_Obvod_1..6_okrsky.pdf' (ids 1005625-1005632, 16.8.2018), but none of these files is on the live site or in the Internet Archive; the archived 2018 council documents are truncated 1 MB captures. No readable 2018 obvody document found.

518263.name: Detva
518263.note: The live website's elections section starts with 2019; no 2018 council resolution on the obvody found (guessed 2018 pages 404). The Internet Archive refused connections throughout (offline for us), so the 2017/2018 pages could not be checked there.

518417.name: Hontianske Nemce
518417.note: Hontianske Nemce's website (hontianskenemce.sk, Dokumenty > Voľby, all pages; úradná tabuľa files from 2022 on) keeps election documents only from 2022 onwards (2022 obvody announcement, 2024, 2026); nothing of this vote. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

518549.name: Kriváň
518549.note: Kriváň has no streets (all 717 addresses by súpisné číslo). The website (obeckrivan.sk, Voľby a referendum) keeps only the 2026 pages; its documents (2026) define the two obvody/okrsky only as 'Pod traťou' and 'Nad traťou' without listing houses, which cannot be written as street/part/number rules. No document of this vote was found live; the Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

518808.name: Sliač
518808.note: The town's website (elections pages and site search) keeps election documents only of 2022 and 2026; no 2018 resolution on the obvody was found; Internet Archive offline.

518921.name: Vígľaš
518921.note: The website's 2018 elections page (volby-do-samospravy-obci-2018.html, reposted 2024) lists forms, candidates and results but no resolution on the volebné obvody; the Internet Archive was offline during the search. The council minutes of 2018 were not found on the site.

521400.name: Haniska
521400.note: The old website has an undated notice (http://archiv.haniska.sk/news/1287.html, between notices of 21.6.2018 and 5.9.2018): "Obec Haniska má 2 volebné obvody v ktorých sa volí 9 poslancov. Volebný obvod č. 1 – Haniska – 8 poslancov; Volebný obvod č. 2 – Haniska, časť Grajciar – 1 poslanec". It would give obvod 1 = part Haniska, obvod 2 = part Grajciar, but it neither names the 2018 elections nor carries a date, the Internet Archive has no capture of it before the vote, and the council sessions of 2018 publish no resolution text; so it cannot be dated as the prompt requires.

521876.name: Perín-Chym
521876.note: No 2018 council resolution on the obvody was found: the old website's archived 2018 elections page holds only voter information; the council minutes on the current website start in 2022. Two images uploaded in September 2018 ('oznam -voľby', 'oznam -voľby1') may be election notices. The municipality's host refused all connections from here for over 50 minutes (after a few requests), so these could not be read; the Internet Archive has no capture of the full-size images.

521884.name: Ploské
521884.note: The current website's elections section starts with 2022; the old website (ploske.sk/dokumenty/…) is archived only in 2017–2019 and its notice board (captured 31 Aug 2018) holds no okrsky or obvody document; nothing else of this vote is archived. Not found.

522279.name: Michalovce
522279.note: The elections page's 2018 section has only the list of polling stations (Volebné okrsky.pdf), no council resolution on the 2018 obvody; the Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

523585.name: Kežmarok
523585.note: The archived 2018 elections page (volby-do-samospravy-obci-2018.html, captured 2019-07-19) links the council's resolution 'Výpis z uznesení zo zasadnutia MsZ o vytvorení volebných obvodov a o určení počtu poslancov' (download_file_f.php?id=1003101), but the Internet Archive has no capture of that file and the old CMS's download links now return 404 on the city's new website.

526045.name: Nižná Slaná
526045.note: The website (elections section from 2022 on, full-text search) has no 2018 resolution on obvody; Internet Archive offline.

526291.name: Stratená
526291.note: All files of the notice board (data/uredni_deska/obsah1..360) and the election pages were checked: the only okrsky/obvody document is that of the elections of 2022 (obsah160_2); for this vote there is none. web.archive.org was unreachable (connection refused) when checked.

526509.name: Gelnica
526509.note: No 2018 resolution or announcement on the obvody found. The old site's elections page (komunalne-volby-2018.phtml?id5=31524, reused for every vote) was captured by the Internet Archive only on 2019-07-22, when it showed the 2019 presidential election; the e-board (elektronicka-uradna-tabula.phtml) only in Dec 2021; the PDFs captured from 2017-2021 carry no titles and none is linked from a captured page of this vote. The live site (rebuilt 2022) has no pages for votes before 2022 and its later elections pages are gone (404).

527840.name: Stropkov
527840.note: No 2018 council resolution or announcement on obvody found: the live site has no 2018 elections page, and the Internet Archive holds almost no stropkov.sk captures from 2018 (CDX checked); MsZ resolutions of 2017 are archived only as redirects.

528099.name: Trebišov
528099.note: The town's elections pages now cover only 2024 and 2026; no 2018 resolution on obvody was found on the website; Internet Archive offline.

528463.name: Krišovská Liesková
528463.note: The obec's current website (new CMS) holds only 2026 election pages; no 2018 obvody resolution found live or by web search. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org, incl. the CDX API) refused connections throughout (about 45 minutes, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

528625.name: Nový Ruskov
528625.note: No 2018 council resolution or announcement on the obvody was found. The municipality's old Joomla site (archived by the Internet Archive) has for the 2018 municipal elections only the delegation address, the recorder of the commission, information for candidates and the list of registered candidates (scan of 18.9.2018, which lists 'volebný obvod č. 1' with 5 seats and 'č. 2' with 2 seats but does not say what each obvod covers). The minutes of the 23rd council session of 23.5.2018 list an item 'Určenie počtu poslancov', but the archived minutes break off before it and no resolution text survives. The live site (novyruskov.sk) has the 2022 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných obvodov' (uznesenie č. 128 of 17.6.2022: obvod 1 = časť Veľký Ruskov, 5 seats; obvod 2 = časť Malý Ruskov, 2 seats), which is not valid for 2018, and a 2014 'Oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov'.

529311.name: Bratislava-Podunajské Biskupice
529311.note: The archived 2018 elections page (19 Sept 2018) links 'Volebné obvody a počty poslancov' (files/documents/miestny-urad/volbyobce2018/volobvody.pdf), but the Internet Archive has no capture of that PDF (only later 302/404 responses) and the live file is gone (404). The council's 2018 resolutions are not online (council materials on the website start in 2024). The Internet Archive was intermittently offline during the search.

529338.name: Bratislava-Vrakuňa
529338.note: Found but not usable as accepted rules: the adopted resolution 397/XXIV/2018 of 26.06.2018 (https://www.vrakuna.sk/data/page/vrakuna.sk/15223/uznesenia-mz-mc-bratislava-vrakuna-zo-dna-26-06-2018.pdf) sets four obvody only by okrsky (1-3, 4-11, 12-13, 14-19; seats 3, 6, 1, 5). The streets of the 2018 obvody and okrsky are in the council material of the same meeting, bod 7, pages 81-90 of https://www.vrakuna.sk/data/page/vrakuna.sk/15221/material-na-rokovanie-miestneho-zastupitelstva-26-06-2018.pdf (27 MB, rejected by the ingest as larger than 20 MiB). Its streets per obvod: 1 = Anízová ... Tymianová incl. all of Hradská (okrsky 1-3); 2 = Amarelková, Arménska, Begóniová, Bučinová, Domašská, Estónska, Ihličnatá, Jazmínová, Jedľová, Kaméliova, Kosodrevinová, Kríková, Malodunajská, Píniová, Podunajská, Poľnohospodárska, Rajecká 1-15 odd and 2-42 even, Ráztočná, Vážska, Vŕbová, Železničná, Žihľavová and Čiližská 1-3 (okrsok 5); 3 = Stavbárska; 4 = Bebravská, Bodvianska, Čiernovodská, Čiližská, Dvojkrížna, Hnilecká, Kazanská, Rajčianska, Slatinská, Toplianska, Toryská, Žitavská. The 2018 announcement linked from the archived elections page (oznamenie-pocet_volebnych_obvodov_okrskovposlancov.pdf) is gone and not archived. Rules copied from the 2019 okrsky rule set were rejected as standing in for the documents.

529346.name: Bratislava-Nové Mesto
529346.note: Found the 2018 resolution (MZ 26/20 of 12.06.2018, https://old.banm.sk/data/files/12336_zoznam-o-urceni-volebnych-obvodov.pdf): 4 obvody, seats 5/7/6/7, defined only by okrsky (1: okrsky 1, 2, 4-11; 2: 12-23; 3: 24-34; 4: 3, 35-45), streets referred to http://www.bnm.sk/volby/201811/index.htm. The street lists there (bnm.sk/volby/20181110/obvody/01-04.pdf) and any 2018 okrsky street list were never archived by the Internet Archive and are gone live; the 2017 mayor's order (11694) lists polling stations only. The 2022 resolution 39/08 groups the same okrsky into the same obvody, so the 2022-10-29 rule set likely fits, but the ingest rejects rules taken wholly from a later source; left for the maintainer.

529354.name: Bratislava-Rača
529354.note: Found the resolution UZN 453/26/06/18/P of 26.06.2018 (https://zastupitelstvo.raca.sk/data/att/26124.pdf): 3 obvody, Rača 10, Krasňany 3, Východné 2 seats; its explanatory report (https://zastupitelstvo.raca.sk/data/att/26054.pdf) defines them by okrsky (Rača 1–11, Krasňany 12–15, Východné 16–18). No okrsky list (streets) of the 2018 municipal elections was found on the website (old site staryweb.raca.sk attachments searched); the okrsky lists of 2017 (staryweb.raca.sk/data/att/4565.pdf) and of the EP election 2019 (staryweb.raca.sk/data/att/8222.pdf) have the same 18 okrsky. Using the 2019 list as a whole substitute was rejected by ingest as not a supplement.

543047.name: Klátova Nová Ves
543047.note: The website (úradné oznamy, 'Voľby 2026 - informácie', site search for okrsky/okrsok/volebné obvody/referendum) holds election notices of October 2026 only, plus old results (NR SR 2016, EP); no resolution on the 2018 obvody. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

544051.name: Vranov nad Topľou
544051.note: The archived 2018 election page (2018-10-23) links 'Oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov a o utvorení volebných obvodov' (download.php?file=s14/sub/Voľby - komunálne 2018 - oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov), but the file is gone live (404) and the Internet Archive never captured it. The vote pages under Úradná tabuľa » Voľby a referendá now hold only results; the announcements published before the vote (on the home-page election sections and news) were removed, and the Internet Archive keeps no okrsky document of this vote (its CDX of vranov.sk download.php files has only the NR SR 2023 okrsky announcement).

545651.name: Veľké Držkovce
545651.note: No 2018 council resolution on the obvody is on the website (resolutions online only from 2026) or in the Internet Archive (captures begin 2020).

546640.name: Dolný Lieskov
546640.note: No 2018 council resolution on the obvody found: the website's elections and council documents start in 2022/2023. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

560103.name: Vysoké Tatry
560103.note: The town's notice board keeps only current items (the October 2026 elections and the July 2026 referendum's minutes, no okrsky announcement); earlier announcements were removed and survive only in the Internet Archive, which was offline (the 2022 documents in this repository come from it). The host rate-limits requests (HTTP 429), so fetching was kept minimal.

560154.name: Smižany
560154.note: The 2018 announcement (uznesenie 437/32/2018 of 14.06.2018; scan) defines obvod 1 as okrsky 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and obvod 2 as okrsok 3, each okrsok named only by its polling station; no 2018 okrsky document with streets is on the website and the Internet Archive was offline. The 2023 okrsky announcement (same 6 polling stations) would give the streets: okrsok 3 = Bystrá, Hornádska, Lúčna, Poľná, Rybníky, Stredná, Štrkovec, Veterná, Vrbová, Za Mostom, Zelená.

598151.name: Košice-Sever
598151.note: Found the council resolution: Uznesenia z XXVI. zasadnutia MZ MČ Košice – Sever zo dňa 13.06.2018, bod 11 (https://web.archive.org/web/20220122213539/https://www.kosicesever.sk/sites/default/files/attachments/26mz_uznesenia_z_13_6_2018.pdf): obvod I = okrsky 1-6 (4 poslanci), II = okrsky 7-12 (5), III = okrsky 13-18 (4). It names okrsky only, and no okrsky document of 2018 (nor 2017) is on the website or in the Internet Archive; the earliest found is the mayor's of 28.01.2019 (presidential election), which the 2019-2020 documents repeat. Filling every obvod wholly from it was rejected by the ingest (supplement may not stand in for the document), so reported not_found; the 2019 okrsky document gives the probable streets.

598186.name: Košice-Staré Mesto
598186.note: The district's elections page and site search hold documents from 2024 on only (presidential and EP elections 2024, referendum and elections 2026); no resolution on the 2018 obvody. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

598224.name: Košice-Západ
598224.note: No 2018 resolution or announcement on the council obvody found: the Internet Archive's index of kosicezapad.sk lists for 2018 only the okrsky notice (urcenie-volebnych-okrskov-a-volebnych-miestnosti-0, 10.11.2018) and candidate lists per obvod, no 'oznámenie o utvorení volebných obvodov'; the current website keeps no 2018 pages.

598682.name: Košice-Dargovských hrdinov
598682.note: No 2018 resolution on the obvody is on the website (the council sessions page 2014-2018 lists no documents; the elections page starts with 2019); Internet Archive offline.

599816.name: Košice-Nad jazerom
599816.note: No okrsky or obvody document of this vote on jazerokosice.sk: the Internet Archive (CDX of the whole domain 2017-2025) holds okrsky lists only for 2019 (presidential), 2022, the 2023 referendum, 2023, and 2024; the live site (rebuilt 2025) and CUET have none.

599824.name: Košice-Juh
599824.note: The 2018 elections page (archived 2018-10-01) links "Oznámenie o určení počtu poslancov a o utvorení volebných obvodov" (https://www.kosicejuh.sk/download/19309/), but the website has deleted it ("Download does not exist") and the Internet Archive has no copy of the file.

599875.name: Košice-Sídlisko Ťahanovce
599875.note: The 2018 elections page (live on both sites) lists candidates, recorder, delegation, campaign info and the commission minutes, but no resolution or announcement on the obvody; the council resolutions online start in 2020; the Internet Archive CDX did not answer.
